lines.sports.title: CAGE CUP
lines.sports.about: TWO AGAINST TWO, UP TO FOUR PLAYERS
lines.sports.join: VERSUS: PRESS 2 ON THE KEYBOARD, OR START ON A PAD, TO JOIN
lines.sports.radio.start: THE {team1} AGAINST THE {team2} IN THE CAGE. HERE WE GO!
lines.sports.radio.over_bar: OVER THE BAR. A GOAL KICK
lines.sports.radio.out: OUT OF THE CAGE! THROWN BACK IN
lines.sports.radio.golden_goal: GOLDEN GOAL! {player} WINS IT FOR THE {team}!
lines.sports.radio.level: LEVEL AT FULL TIME: GOLDEN GOAL! THE NEXT ONE WINS IT.
lines.sports.radio.draw: FULL TIME: A DRAW IN THE CAGE.

notes.sports.title: The football game's title: the cup played in the cage (a walled pitch).
notes.sports.about: Under the title: two footballers a side, and up to four people can play.
notes.sports.menu.match: A mode: you against the CPU.
notes.sports.menu.versus: A mode: two to four players.
notes.sports.menu.back: Back to the title screen (a menu entry).
notes.sports.menu.rematch: After the match: play it again.
notes.sports.menu.menu: After the match: back to the menu.
notes.sports.join: 2 is the key on a keyboard, START the button on a gamepad: keep them as they are.
notes.sports.join.ready: A row of the join screen: player {player} (P1 to P4) plays for {team} and has joined. Two spaces before READY.
notes.sports.join.waiting: A row of the join screen: player {player} (P1 to P4), for {team}, has not joined yet (the dots: waiting).
notes.sports.join.play: After a key or button's name: press it to start the match.
notes.sports.join.back: After a key or button's name: press it to go back.
notes.sports.team.gulls: A team's name (seagulls), plural: THE GULLS.
notes.sports.team.rust: A team's name, used like a plural: THE RUST.
notes.sports.radio: The match commentator's name: the cage's radio station.
notes.sports.radio.start: The commentator at kickoff: {team1} and {team2} are the teams' names.
notes.sports.radio.over_bar: The commentator: the shot went over the crossbar, so the defenders restart with a goal kick.
notes.sports.radio.out: The commentator: the ball flew out of the cage and is thrown back in.
notes.sports.radio.goal: The commentator: {player} scored for {team}; {score1} - {score2} is the score after it (the GULLS' first).
notes.sports.radio.goal_team: The commentator: {team} scored; {score1} - {score2} is the score after it.
notes.sports.radio.golden_goal: The commentator: in extra time the first goal wins; {player} scored it for {team}.
notes.sports.radio.half: The commentator at half time: each team's name and its goals.
notes.sports.radio.level: The commentator: the score is level after normal time, so the next goal wins.
notes.sports.radio.full: The commentator at the final whistle: {team} won, {high} - {low}.
notes.sports.hud.half1: The match clock in the first half (1ST: first): {clock} the time left, e.g. 0:45.
notes.sports.hud.half2: The match clock in the second half (2ND: second).
notes.sports.hud.golden: In place of the clock in extra time: the next goal wins.
notes.sports.hud.score1: The score box's left half: the GULLS' name and goals.
notes.sports.hud.score2: The score box's right half: the RUST's goals and name.
notes.sports.kickoff: Before play starts from the centre.
notes.sports.results.win: At the final whistle: {team} won (the team's name is plural).
notes.sports.results.goal: A goal in the results: {time} when (minutes:seconds), {player} who scored, {team} for which team. Two spaces after the time.
notes.action.pass: Pass the ball (or slide in to tackle): an action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.
notes.action.shoot: Shoot (hold to fill the meter): an action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.
notes.action.lob: Lob the ball over a defender: an action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.

brief: The sports slice: two-against-two football (soccer) in a walled cage, in the spirit of Sensible Soccer, for up to four players: the GULLS (NOOR and BEX) against the RUST (DRAGO and KIT); the footballers' gender is not stated. A radio commentator, CAGE RADIO, calls the match in short, excited lines in capitals. Two halves on the clock; if it ends level, a golden goal: the next goal wins.
